# Alerus Adds Mortgage Banker Jackie Chenery in Arizona


##### September 16, 2026


Alerus is pleased to announce Jackie Chenery has joined the company as a mortgage banker serving Scottsdale and Tempe, Arizona.


With more than 30 years of mortgage industry experience, Jackie specializes in simplifying the lending process and helping clients navigate even the most complex financing situations with confidence. She works with a wide range of borrowers, from first-time homebuyers to high-net-worth individuals, business owners, and real estate investors, providing customized mortgage solutions tailored to each client’s unique financial goals.


Having spent her entire career in the Phoenix-area mortgage market, Jackie brings deep local knowledge and extensive industry expertise to her role. She is based in Alerus’ Tempe office.
